Refuse source checkouts, local/npx and Yarn installations with actionable instructions. Check-only and already-current paths never install.

Distinguish registry failures and unavailable releases from installation failure. Announce writes even for piped/JSON runs; keep machine-readable stdout clean. Installation failure reports UPDATE_FAILED, a manual recovery command and an output tail bounded to 2,000 characters; sanitize anything rendered to the terminal.

Support persisted update.mode values nudge and off, defaulting to nudge, without automatic installation. Passive checks work for piped/JSON commands but keep human notices separate from the daily fetch clock. Nonempty CI or off mode suppresses checks. Network failure stays silent and retries. Ordinary success/error envelopes and generated hook reminders expose valid cached signals consistently; quiet/off behavior suppresses notices. The update command itself must not append a stale post-command notice.

- Error detail output tail bounded to 2,000 characters; terminal output sanitized; UPDATE_FAILED for timeout/nonzero/start failure; RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND for absent releases and NETWORK_ERROR for invalid/unavailable registry response.
